Mood Board

1,220 sq ft · 2 bed / 3 bath

Style: Black-and-White Graphic Contemporary — black-and-white checkerboard floors and matte black hardware throughout, with clean-lined fixtures over rustic ones and a dark gray tweed-chenille sofa keeping the living room in the same neutral palette. Baths repeat the look in sea-glass tile with black grout over dark floors.

A full remodel: kitchen, dining, and living refreshed in place; both bedrooms and their ensuites rebuilt; the downstairs half bath upgraded to a full curbless wet room; new closets, stairs, and hardware throughout. Layout changes stay minor — a 6" wall shift for the half bath's shower and toilet, opened walls between the primary closets, and a resized tub with a respaced vanity in the primary bath.

Bathrooms

The wet zones — entryways and all three baths — take a small-format charcoal mosaic floor, paired with Lilah, Opal: a glossy, sea-glass-look wall tile run floor-to-ceiling with black grout, plus matte black fixtures and hardware throughout.

By Room
Primary Bedroom Primary Bathroom

A shared kids' room built for privacy and symmetry: twin beds flank the window, each with its own nightstand, and a ceiling-hung curtain draws closed to cut light pollution between the two beds. Walk-in closets with more privacy curtains, cabinets, desktops, mirrors.

Kitchen Dining Room Living Room Entryway Stairs

No changes to the kitchen's white cabinetry, stainless appliances, granite counters, or backsplash. Two counter stools at the island; the dining desk stations use low chairs instead. New kitchen window treatment.

Counters continue from the kitchen, dropped to table height. 48" round marble table seats 4-6 (6 chairs shared between dining table and computer stations). Bi-fold door to the patio.

Power-recline sleeper sofa faces the built-in entertainment center, which stays as-is.

Archway passage between living room and kitchen with a wall-hung arched mirror.

Reclaimed hardwood stairway leads to the upstairs bedroom suites.

Downstairs Bathroom Under-Stairs Closet

Half bath converted to a curbless wet-room bath — shower behind a fixed glass panel, toilet on the opposite wall. Ceiling rain head and handheld wand, corner sink/mirrors, 28" pocket door.

Wedge-shaped closet under the stair stringer, headroom 93" to 31". Oak shelving, granite counter, clothes rod, medicine cabinet, electrical outlets and an over-mirror vanity light with 6'6" standing headroom over 28" x 21" floor space.

Proposed downstairs bath, replacing the 1/2 bath: 61"x61", widened 6" into the entry (67"x61").
